help.mobile:
Up/Down - Move Conductor's Time
Left/Right - Change Sections
Up/Down (On The Right) - Decrease/Increase Note Sustain Length
Hold Y to Increase/Decrease move by 4x

C - Preview Chart
A - Playtest Chart
X - Stop/Resume Song

Hold H and touch to Select Note(s)
Z - Hide Action TouchPad Buttons
V/D - Zoom in/out
help.desktop:
W/S/Mouse Wheel - Move Conductor's Time
A/D - Change Sections
Q/E - Decrease/Increase Note Sustain Length
Hold Shift/Alt to Increase/Decrease move by 4x

F12 - Preview Chart
Enter - Playtest Chart
Space - Stop/Resume song

Alt + Click - Select Note(s)
Shift + Click - Select/Unselect Note(s)
Right Click - Selection Box

R - Reset Section
Shift + R - Go Back to the Start of the Song
Z/X - Zoom in/out
Left/Right - Change Snap

Ctrl + Z - Undo
Ctrl + Y - Redo
Ctrl + X - Cut Selected Notes
Ctrl + C - Copy Selected Notes
Ctrl + V - Paste Copied Notes
Ctrl + A - Select all in current Section
Ctrl + S - Quicksave
help.pitch_desktop:
Left Bracket / Right Bracket - Change Song Playback Rate
ALT + Left Bracket / Right Bracket - Reset Song Playback Rate

events.dadbattle_spotlight:
Used in Dad Battle,
Value 1: 0/1 = ON/OFF,
2 = Target Dad
3 = Target BF
events.hey:
Plays the "Hey!" animation from Bopeebo,
Value 1: BF = Only Boyfriend, GF = Only Girlfriend,
Something else = Both.
Value 2: Custom animation duration,
leave it blank for 0.6s
events.set_gf_speed:
Sets GF head bopping speed,
Value 1: 1 = Normal speed,
2 = 1/2 speed, 4 = 1/4 speed etc.
Used on Fresh during the beatbox parts.

Warning: Value must be integer!
events.philly_glow:
Exclusive to Week 3
Value 1: 0/1/2 = OFF/ON/Reset Gradient
 
No, i won't add it to other weeks.
events.kill_henchmen: For Mom's songs, don't use this please, i love them :(
events.add_camera_zoom:
Used on MILF on that one "hard" part
Value 1: Camera zoom add (Default: 0.015)
Value 2: UI zoom add (Default: 0.03)
Leave the values blank if you want to use Default.
events.bg_freaks_expression: Should be used only in "school" Stage!
events.trigger_bg_ghouls: Should be used only in "schoolEvil" Stage!
events.play_animation:
Plays an animation on a Character,
once the animation is completed,
the animation changes to Idle

Value 1: Animation to play.
Value 2: Character (Dad, BF, GF)
events.camera_follow_pos:
Value 1: X
Value 2: Y

The camera won't change the follow point
after using this, for getting it back
to normal, leave both values blank.
events.alt_idle_animation:
Sets a specified postfix after the idle animation name.
You can use this to trigger 'idle-alt' if you set
Value 2 to -alt

Value 1: Character to set (Dad, BF or GF)
Value 2: New postfix (Leave it blank to disable)
events.screen_shake:
Value 1: Camera shake
Value 2: HUD shake

Every value works as the following example: "1, 0.05".
The first number (1) is the duration.
The second number (0.05) is the intensity.
events.change_character:
Value 1: Character to change (Dad, BF, GF)
Value 2: New character's name
events.change_scroll_speed:
Value 1: Scroll Speed Multiplier (1 is default)
Value 2: Time it takes to change fully in seconds.
events.set_property:
Value 1: Variable name
Value 2: New value
events.play_sound:
Value 1: Sound file name
Value 2: Volume (Default: 1), ranges from 0 to 1
events.set_camera_bopping:
Sets how camera should bop.
Value 1: Frequency (in beats)
Value 2: Intensity scale (1 for default)
events.lyric_event:
Displays a lyric text in the middle of the screen.
Value 1: Text to display (leave blank to fade out).
Value 2: Text color name or hex (leave blank for white).
events.add_secondary_icon:
Value 1: Side of Health Bar (Dad, BF)
Value 2: Swap position of BF and GF icons when GF Sing (true, false)
events.change_ui:
Change noteskin and notesplash.
Value 1: Noteskin name (leave blank to keep current)
Value 2: Notesplash name (leave blank to keep current)
Value 3: UI style name (leave blank to keep current)
